hooks.name: qh session start
hooks.description: Puts the qh status and the task card into context.

action.command: [ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.quality/qh/bin/qh.js" ] || exit 0; node "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.quality/qh/bin/qh.js" hook session-start

hooks.name: qh stop gate
hooks.description: Runs the built-in checks at the end of a turn and judges the evidence. Blocks with exit 0 + {"decision":"block","reason"}.

action.command: [ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.quality/qh/bin/qh.js" ] || exit 0; node "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.quality/qh/bin/qh.js" hook stop
